episodes.synopsis: Kotarou wakes up in a deserted town, and the only thing he knows is that he must talk to the girl on the hill.
episodes.title: Three Cups of Coffee

episodes.synopsis: As Kagari's research continues to take its toll on her, Kotarou looks to help her out and realizes the true significance of her theory of life.
episodes.title: Honeymoon Over a Silent Ocean

episodes.synopsis: Kotarou gets the occult club back together one last time to help Kagari finish her theory. Will she make it in time?
episodes.title: The Truth Nobody Knows

episodes.synopsis: The story returns to when Kotarou was a superhuman without a cause, the Earth-Saving Hunter.
episodes.title: Earth-Saving Hunter

episodes.synopsis: Life changes drastically for Kotarou as Esaka invites him to join Guardian.
episodes.title: Superhuman Qualities

episodes.synopsis: Kotarou returns to Kazamatsuri, where Guardian begins a fateful operation that ends in tragedy.
episodes.title: The Forest of Tragedy

episodes.synopsis: Unable to stay in Japan anymore, Kotarou flees to a war zone, where he comes to a standstill yet again. Will he be able to move on?
episodes.title: Moving On From a Standstill

episodes.synopsis: Back in Japan, Kotarou finds himself in Kazamatsuri once again, where he meets quite a few familiar faces.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: As Kotarou infiltrates deeper into Gaia and learns more about the group, he is forced to make a choice that Kagari may not necessarily approve of.
episodes.title: Battle Behind the Scenes

episodes.synopsis: In order to save Kagari, Kotarou faces off with Gaia and Guardian.
episodes.title: Follower of the Lodestar

episodes.synopsis: In order to rewrite Kagari’s fate, Kotarou heads toward the final battle.
episodes.title: A Promise Fulfilled with You
